Container.Name: disc-ripper
Container.Overview: Rips and encodes discs from its own web UI. Optical drives are found by serial number at start-up; no --privileged needed.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings and the SQLite database (cache only)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The Barry-server share, mounted as /data like in Radarr, Sonarr and Jellyfin

Config.Name: Work area
Config.Description: Cache-only exclusive share for in-progress rips and encodes

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone; must match the Raspberry Pi's clock

Config.Name: Busy secret
Config.Description: Shared secret unraid-backend sends to /api/busy (X-Shutdown-Secret). Use a long random string; blank turns /api/busy off.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as; also owns the drive device nodes
